title: Controlling Desires & Seeking Divine Pleasure
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَطْفِئْ نَارَ الشَّهَوَاتِ مِنْ قَلْبِيْ ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنْهُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ لَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنِّيْ
transliteration: Allāhumma aṭfi' nārash-shahawāti min qalbī, waṣrif ʿanhu kulla shay'in lā yurḍīka ʿannī
translation: Oh Allah! Extinguish the fire of desires in my heart and redirect my heart to all that which pleases You.
reference: A general supplication rooted in Islamic teachings on chastity and sincerity
